Title: Document 3
Content: Source: Male Cuban revolutionary sympathizer, interview in Cuba with United States anthropologist, published in `text(1969)`.

I'm against women's liberation. Most of the older generation is also. The Revolution gave women a lot more freedom by giving them jobs, so now they don't depend so much on their husbands. I think that's not right. I expect my wife to stay home and look after the house. She has plenty to do here. She owes herself to me and the children.
